body:
Develop's AppVeyor build has been red since #5882 (last green: build 9409; failing: 9428). All red jobs are VS 2015:

- **C2338 "The C++ Standard doesn't provide a hash for this type"** in `test-alt-string_cpp11`: `detect_indexable_keys` named `std::hash<StringType>` in the same expression as the `emplace_new_key` probe. VS 2015 static-asserts on `std::hash` of a type without one instead of reporting a substitution failure. The probe is now two-staged, so `std::hash` is only named once the object type has `emplace_new_key`.
- **C4996 (error under /WX)** in `abi_compat_diag_on`, `abi_compat_diag_off` and `abi_compat_inline_ns` (Debug x86): `std::copy` with raw pointers on the frame stack. Replaced by plain loops.

No behavior change; the amalgamation is regenerated. Checked locally with `unit-alt-string`, `unit-ordered_json`, `unit-class_parser` and `unit-regression2`. VS 2015 itself is not reproduced locally; AppVeyor has to confirm it (serial queue, hours).

## Breaks the public API?

No breaking changes. Only private members of `json_sax_dom_parser` change.
